create_quark_quantization_config: create a QuarkConfig from a quantization config dict with kv_cache_group and pack_method parameters
build_quantized_linear_method: build a QuarkLinearMethod to apply Quark quantization to linear layers in a vLLM model
test_quark_quantization_scheme: test whether a weight and input config matches FP8 W8A8, INT8 W8A8, MXFP4 W4A8, or OCP-MX quantization scheme
run_kv_cache_quantization: run QuarkKVCacheMethod to load and validate FP8 per-tensor KV cache scaling factors from Quark checkpoints
summarize_quantization_config: summarize a Quark quantization config by matching layer names to weight and input tensor quantization settings
